question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched control over the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced by ongoing anti-corruption purges that have removed senior military and political figures without destabilizing core structures, drives the 95.9% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Recent leadership gatherings such as the Beidaihe conclave and public addresses on party discipline and economic priorities signal institutional consolidation ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027, where Xi is widely expected to secure a fourth term as general secretary. No designated successor or visible elite opposition has emerged, and age norms appear set to apply mainly to subordinates rather than the paramount leader. Realistic scenarios that could still shift outcomes include a sudden health crisis, major unforeseen scandal, or abrupt elite realignment, though none show signs of materializing in the near term.
